In the headlines: “The eight-year-old bullish trend in the stock market breaks during Diwali, marking the start of Samvat 2083 with a decline” (Loktej English). “Middle East latest: Saudi Aramco building in Riyadh damaged in attempted attack” (The National).
One session says little about the long run. Oil, the Iran war and foreign flows remain the big swing factors.

drivers.p: Brent is down 16.4% in a week. India imports most of its crude, so cheaper oil eases inflation, supports the rupee and helps oil users.
The rupee is at 93.89 per dollar, stronger than a week ago. A firmer rupee eases import costs and tends to steady foreign investors.
